summary: Retested the 8 fixes from iteration_2 plus the Phase 2 regression set. Vitest: 59/59 pass (the existing 52 plus 7 new mocked-fetch tests in tests/phase2-retry-ratelimit-mocked.test.ts). Live pytest: 10/10 pass (backend/tests/test_phase2_retest_iter3.py). Playwright covered the dashboard, the /admin/automatizaciones delivery list and creating an appointment in the panel. Only 2 real Resend sends were used (SALON_NOTICE_CONTACT to delivered+it3notice*@resend.dev, both ACCEPTED with a provider id). Everything else used reserved test domains. All 8 fixes are verified. Two minor issues remain (see action_items).

verified_fixes.1_rate_limit_429: PASS (mocked fetch). Delivery is FAILED with errorMessage '[rate_limited] ...' and rateLimited=true. The job goes back to PENDING, attempts are unchanged and nextAttemptUtc is now+~11min. The batch stops after the first 429: a second due job was left untouched (attempts 0). While cooling down, a direct send does not call the provider, records FAILED with rateLimited, and gets a retry job about 11 min out.
verified_fixes.2_direct_send_queue_retries: PASS (mocked fetch). A 503 and a network error each create a RETRY_EMAIL_DELIVERY job (dedupKey retry:<key>, payload replyTo kept). A 422 creates no job. The worker re-dispatches the FAILED delivery: it becomes ACCEPTED with the provider id, the job is COMPLETED and contact_email (Reply-To) is forwarded. The contact route, notices.ts and newsletter verify/welcome all pass retryViaQueue:true.
verified_fixes.3_automations_ui: PASS. delivery-provider-id is rendered ('ID proveedor: 01a1bca7-...') and delivery-error-message is rendered ('Motivo: No enviado: dominio reservado para pruebas.').
verified_fixes.4_stale_cancelled_appointment: PASS. Booked then cancelled before the worker ran. Confirmation, CLIENT_WELCOME and reminders ended CANCELLED ('Descartado: la cita está cancelada.'), APPOINTMENT_CANCELLED ended COMPLETED. Only the cancellation email was recorded.
verified_fixes.5_campaign_zero_accepted: PASS. The campaign is FAILED with sentAtUtc null. The recipient is FAILED and its errorText is MANAGED_MARKETING_BLOCKED_MESSAGE (the real reason).
verified_fixes.6_dashboard_simulated_text: PASS. Text: '191 correo(s) guardados en buzón local (no enviados: destinatarios de dominios reservados de prueba o anteriores a la activación del proveedor).' 'falta proveedor' is gone.
verified_fixes.7_scheduler: PASS. schedulerLeases.lastRunAt moved from 19:30:43 to 19:35:43 (exactly 5 min), and the log shows '[scheduler] cola procesada'.
verified_fixes.8_panel_immediate_emails: PASS. A panel appointment (EQ-4XJZAB) had SALON_NOTICE_BOOKING, CLIENT_WELCOME and APPOINTMENT_CONFIRMATION COMPLETED about 4 ms after createdAt, with no cron run.

minor.issue: A rate-limited job that is put back to PENDING still adds to failedJobs, so scheduler/cron stats report it as a failure.

Edge case: if the client's first appointment is cancelled before the welcome job runs (for example during the 11-min provider cooldown), the welcome job is CANCELLED. Later bookings never re-create it because the 'previous appointments === 0' check fails, so the client never gets a welcome.
The internal job types are not documented (no RETRY_EMAIL_DELIVERY / rate-limit cooldown mention). Optional.

ui_bugs.issue: EMAIL RESEND shows 'Pendiente de configurar' while the checklist marks 'Proveedor de email activo (Resend gestionado por Emergent)' as done. The cause is that integrationConnection {provider:'EMAIL_RESEND'} stays in status PENDING_CREDENTIALS and is never synced with getEmailProviderConfig().configured.

issues: SIMULATED_LOCAL 'Motivo: No enviado: dominio reservado para pruebas.' is shown in destructive red, as if it were an error. A muted colour would fit an informational reason better.
The missing-notice-email warning has a 'Configurar' link to /admin/configuracion, which RECEPTION cannot access.

action_items: Sync the EMAIL_RESEND integrationConnection status (or the dashboard card) with getEmailProviderConfig().configured, so the card no longer says 'Pendiente de configurar' when managed Resend is active.
Optional: do not count rate-limit reschedules in failedJobs, and let CLIENT_WELCOME be re-created when the welcome job was cancelled only because the appointment was cancelled.
Optional: show SIMULATED_LOCAL reasons in a muted colour, and hide the 'Configurar' link from RECEPTION.
critical_code_review_comments: The provider cooldown is held in process memory (providerCooldownUntil). That is acceptable for a single Next instance, and jobs already rescheduled by +11 min survive a restart.

SEND_TRANSACTIONAL_EMAIL confirmation jobs are discarded only when the appointment is CANCELLED, not when its version is newer (rescheduled). The email renders current appointment data, so this is acceptable.
A campaign where every recipient was SUPPRESSED_SKIPPED also ends FAILED. That is debatable but honest.
agenda-manager.tsx and login-form.tsx still have no data-testid attributes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of retested flows (1 low-priority UI inconsistency)

seed_data_creation: None. Test data used TEST_ / example.com recipients. The new vitest file deletes its own records by id/dedupKey. Bookings made by pytest are cancelled in teardown, and panel appointment EQ-4XJZAB was cancelled. salonSettings.noticeEmail and contactEmail were left null (contactEmail was already null at start).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real Resend sends this run: 2 (SALON_NOTICE_CONTACT). test_phase2_retest_iter3.py sends 1 real email per run (test_contact_notice_real_send_accepted; it xfails gracefully if rate limited). The mocked vitest file sets EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY in-process and mocks fetch, so it never hits the provider. Booking horizon is about 8-10 weeks, so find_slot uses weeks 4-10. The frontend .env exposes APP_URL rather than REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. One pre-existing FAILED job (appt-init:c0mw87573..., 4/4 attempts, from before the fix) is still in the queue.
